caption: Dashboard right after login: '30 days left' with Subscribe and Cancel, no card asked, and the account already holds 100 sample people and 50 sample companies.
The Contact Importer only continues after you tick a box agreeing that all imported email addresses have given permission to receive your emails; we left it unticked.
The PNG attachment opens as a text view of the image, with 'Zo' followed by a broken character instead of 'Zoë'; the account name is hidden.
Person Dashboard: our two hand-made test people at the top, between the 'Sample' records, 102 people in total; the owner name is hidden.
Spreadsheet Export column picker, with Record Information including ID and Memo.
Files & Exports: the person export (2 entries, status Completed) is waiting here as a CSV download; the account name is hidden.
